Kodiak

PVC Wall & Ceiling Panels

THE STRONG CHOICE FOR PVC WALL & CEILING LINER PANELS

Kodiak PVC Wall & Ceiling Liner Panels are a sanitary product designed to clad indoor wall and ceiling surfaces for any type of project. Kodiak interlocking panels provide a smooth finish with no exposed fasteners. Available in both white and grey with matching trims.

NOW AVAILABLE IN GREY

Kodiak PVC Wall & Ceiling Liner Panels are now available in grey. The panels are 16″ wide and come in lengths of 10, 12′, 16′ and 20′. The matching trims available are J-Trim, 90° Trim, 2-piece H Trim, Inside Corner Cove, and 2-Piece Multi Corner.

KEY ADVANTAGES INCLUDE:

  • 3/8″ thick panel combined with heavy wall thickness gives Kodiak outstanding strength
  • Cost effective vs other wall systems like painted drywall.
  • Can be used for new construction or retrofit
  • Meets CFIA (Canada) and FDA (U.S.A.) requirements for walls and ceilings
  • Available in standard and custom lengths
  • Hidden fasteners provide smooth finish
  • Made from 100% virgin PVC, Kodiak is highly resistent to chemicals and unaffected by moisture.
  • Ideal replacement for conventional wall systems
  • Supports attic insulation loads
  • Pre-punched nailing flange
  • Bright clean appearance
  • Available in white 100% virgin PVC. Other colours are available. Please ask your dealer for more information.
  • Works perfectly with Kodiak Slatwall PVC Panels

  • Dairy, Hog, and Poultry Farms

Specifications

  • KODIAK PVC Panels in WHITE are 16″ wide and come in 8′, 10′, 12′, 14′, 16′, 18′ and 20′ lengths.
  • KODIAK PVC Panels in GREY are 16″ wide and come in  10′, 12′, 16′ and 20′ lengths. 
  • Custom lengths are available.
  • KODIAK PVC Panels are white or grey with matching trims.
  • All trims are 12′ in length.
  • Flame Spread value of 20 (CAN/ULC S102.2) & 15 (ASTM E84). Always refer to local fire and building codes before installing. 
  • Meets CFIA (Canada) and FDA (U.S.A.) approval requirements for walls and ceilings.
  • 99.9% kill for bacteria and fungi using ISO 22196 test.
